title: Cosmic Bridge Portal
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large teal-skinned female figure with closed eyes, facial markings, and ornate dark armor, her head surrounded by floating demonic masks and purple crystals. A wooden bridge crosses dark water with lily pads, leading to a glowing blue portal with a silhouetted figure, set against ancient stone ruins under a starry night sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a large teal-skinned female warrior with closed eyes, facial runes, and ornate purple armor, her head encircled by floating demonic masks and glowing purple crystals.
